purpose: Test a causal object-local measurement-first current-frame output with exact nearest-anchor missing fallback on genuinely unused RU-APC RGB-D development data.

predecessor.failed_condition: Cross-fitted all-frame improvement was +0.1408% versus the frozen +5% minimum.
predecessor.diagnosis: The maximum anchor/measurement disagreement gate selected the low-disagreement region where the anchor was already good and rejected 1,019 available frames where the current measurement was better 98.72% of the time.

source.scene_object_map_source: The official base archive test_targets_bop19.json maps each scene 1-14 to the same-numbered target object and one target instance per image.

source_encoding_audit.scope: All 5964 GT-present mapped target-object entries; source encoding only, with no replay-window selection or pose-error computation.

rotation.adapter: none; use the shared strict BOP parser

visible_mask_metadata.availability_source: decoded visible-mask PNG count; px_count_visib is only a bounded source-integrity check

source.clock: Order frames by BOP image ID within each scene and use a nominal 30 Hz clock; hardware timestamps are unavailable.
source.association: Oracle scene-to-target-object association from the official base archive; duplicate target instances in a frame are forbidden.
limitations: ground-truth visible masks as isolated pose-estimator inputs
development scenes are organized by target object

development.labels: scene_gt.json and scene_gt_info.json may be opened only after this protocol, builder, inference runner, estimator, evaluator, and tests are committed together.

sealed.labels: Do not download or inspect until every M5-R6 development condition passes and a separate sealed protocol is committed.

selection.observation_available: A GT-present target frame is available only when decoded visible-mask area is at least 0.001 of the image, valid-depth ratio inside the mask is at least 0.5, and at least four visible masked depth pixels are valid.
selection.gt_absent_frame_policy: Exclude from replay because pose error is not evaluable; never count it as natural missing.
selection.window_rule: For each target object in its mapped scene, split GT-present rows into source-frame-consecutive segments. Among eligible 128-frame windows starting available, choose the window with most naturally unavailable frames and break ties by earliest source image ID.
selection.track_rule: Exactly one selected 128-frame window for each of all 14 target objects.
selection.preinitialization: Every selected window starts with an available FoundationPose measurement.

baseline.role: Sole persistent pose-state owner for baseline and proposed outputs.

proposed_family.description: Estimate current-measurement reliability from causal object-local mask/depth history and measurement-to-measurement constant-twist innovation. On available frames, apply a bounded current-frame move from the nearest anchor toward the measurement when reliability passes the candidate threshold. Anchor disagreement is recorded as staleness risk but is never itself a rejection condition. Never feed the current-frame output back into persistent state. On missing frames, output the nearest anchor bit-for-bit while confidence decays with gap length and last observed anchor staleness.
proposed_family.raw_foundationpose_score_policy: Record top score and margin for audit, but exclude both from filtering and confidence.
proposed_family.forced_reacquisition_policy: Forbidden. No counter or measurement can take persistent pose ownership.
proposed_family.candidate_selection: Leave one object ID out. In each fold select the candidate with greatest training macro-object all-frame relative improvement, breaking exact ties by candidate_order. Development evidence is the cross-fitted held-out concatenation. Any future sealed candidate is the modal fold winner with the same tie rule.

evaluation.primary_aggregation: One track per object followed by equal-weight macro mean across all 14 represented objects.
evaluation.missing_frame_loss: The same macro-object aggregation restricted to naturally unavailable GT-present frames; every object must contribute at least one missing frame.
evaluation.confidence_metric: Spearman correlation between proposed uncertainty and proposed normalized pose error on naturally unavailable cross-fitted frames.

bootstrap.unit: Paired hierarchical resampling of represented objects, then complete tracks within sampled objects.
bootstrap.reported_bound: 10th percentile of cross-fitted paired all-frame relative macro-object improvement.

evaluation.stop_rule: Any failed development condition stops M5-R6 and forbids YCB-V access.

sealed_policy.method: After a full development pass, freeze the modal candidate and outcome-blind YCB-V track selection in a separate commit before downloading YCB-V.
sealed_policy.gate: Reuse all numerical and structural development gates without relaxation.
sealed_policy.reopen_policy: The first YCB-V evaluator-label open is final. Any method, configuration, metric, selection, or gate change requires another genuinely new data source and protocol ID.

claim_boundary.development_allowed: Recorded RU-APC cluttered-shelf RGB-D replay with nominal timing, oracle target association, GT visible masks, 14-object grouped cross-fitting, natural support loss, measurement-first current-frame output, exact nearest missing fallback, and object-local uncertainty.
claim_boundary.sealed_allowed_if_passed: One object-disjoint YCB-V validation of the RU-APC-developed measurement-first confidence gate.
forbidden: claiming missing-frame pose improvement from structural equality alone
retuning on consumed XYZ-IBD, HB, or LM-O outcomes
using anchor disagreement as a standalone measurement rejection rule
accessing YCB-V after a failed development gate

execution_order: commit this protocol, measurement-first core, RU-APC builder, generalized inference/evaluator, and tests before reading RU-APC pose labels or any pose/error outcome
build the RU-APC development bundle and record exact source/code/data hashes
run label-blind FoundationPose inference once on all available selected frames
evaluate frozen candidates with leave-one-object-out cross-fitting
apply every numerical and structural gate
only after a full pass, commit a separate modal-candidate and YCB-V sealed implementation
only then download YCB-V and perform one sealed-label open
